L&G’s digital infrastructure fund makes its first mobile towers investment in a deal with DigitalBridge and TD Asset Management for VodafoneZiggo assets.

DigitalBridge, L&G and TD Asset Management (TDAM) have struck an agreement to acquire the mobile tower assets of VodafoneZiggo, a telecom operator in the Netherlands, and combine them with DigitalBridge’s tower business in Belgium.
